purpose: Deny an action emphatically, often with irritation.
keywords: Vます stem + やしない; Vている → Vていやしない
No matter how often I call, he never answers.
I will never believe a story like that.
formation: Vます stem + やしない; Vている → Vていやしない
restrictions: Often contrasts what should happen with what never happens.
mistake: This is an emphatic negative, not the suffix やすい.
